headline: The whole panel in one minute: human skills are the answer, and the students are leading.
story: NFTE led a panel during UN General Assembly week: Beyond the Algorithm: Why Human Skills Are the Answer to an AI-Shaped World. This is the overview of that panel: J.D., Pearson, Aflatoun and an NFTE student, one idea each.
The spine: AI can help, but human skills stay ours, and the students are already leading. It ends on the student and a warm line from J.D. Confident and hopeful, never afraid of AI.

LOOPS: L1 <q>The skills AI can't replace</q> opens 0:00 and closes at 00:05 when J.D. names them. L2 <q>Who is this future for?</q> opens 00:05 with the panel title and closes in the BUTTON with the student. STAKES: the young people in that room will live in the world these choices build.
